expected_information_boundaries: CURRENT_RETRIEVAL is candidate_only: only candidate atoms are retrievable, and claims outside the candidate set cannot be filled from memory or general knowledge.
SOURCE_ROUTE is capture_first_source_intake with boundary 发行人 IR 主源和商业数据未形成完整生产路线: any fact requiring an unavailable production route is declared unserviceable, not false or absent disclosure.
NUMERIC_FACT is company_reported_exact: only exact company-reported numeric facts are accepted, with no analyst-constructed, model-derived, peer-implied or approximate numeric attribution.
REVIEWED_EVIDENCE_READER is reviewed_evidence_only: only reviewed evidence may be inspected, and non-reviewed material cannot be promoted into the case record.
CASE_FACT_PRESENCE is visibility_semantics_only: it reports only whether a fact is loaded/present and whether it is a typed gap, without establishing truth, materiality or interpretation.
DETERMINISTIC_RENDERER is render_only: renderer output cannot alter, interpret or authorize facts.

Counterparty statements from TSM, MU, NVDA or other suppliers are speaker-attributed read-through only and cannot be converted into Dell-specific allocation, timing, yield, utilization or realized economics.

Company backlog, orders and AI-specific management commentary are unaudited and not shipped revenue, realized profit or realized cash; they may be used only through explicit conversion tests owned by the relevant specialist.

Independent industry demand sequences and channel-inventory data are not authorized under current SOURCE_ROUTE completeness; any conclusion depending on such external sequence is a typed gap/boundary item.
No consolidated margin, OCF/FCF or working-capital movement may be reattributed to AI product contribution unless an authorized proxy rule is recorded and the residual remains disclosed as inferred.
research_as_of is null, so no global cutoff or freshness anchor exists yet and cross-role comparisons remain provisional until a case-wide anchor is set.
stop_conditions: Each primary owner has completed its owned facets with REVIEWED_EVIDENCE_READER, NUMERIC_FACT and CASE_FACT_PRESENCE outputs recorded at least once per required atom.
Every required slot has a rendered fact-anchored draft or an explicit typed gap declaration; no required slot is left silently empty.
COUNTEREVIDENCE has filed at least one proposition-targeted challenge for each positive thesis: order durability, realized margin capture, realized cash conversion, and supply-driven scarcity.
Each challenged proposition has a recorded response from its primary owner, or an explicit unresolved boundary item if the source route cannot service the challenge.
SOURCE_ROUTE boundary gaps are declared as unserviceable/typed gap items, not converted into negative findings or silent coverage gaps.

Shared facts used by more than one role such as inventory, receivables, backlog and customer concentration are read consistently across working_capital_risk, conversion_and_durability, issuer_counterevidence and upstream_or_demand_counterevidence.
No management backlog, order, AI-margin or AI-cash commentary has been upgraded into audited realized profit or realized cash by any specialist.
The coordination questions have recorded answers or explicit deferral statements with owner assignment.
The final judgment states what is supported, what is inference, what is typed gap, and what would change the judgment.

predecessor_contract_feedback.correction_rule: Correct every listed violation in one submission. Preserve the completed analysis and authority; merge or select distinct items when a bounded array is over capacity, and do not add facts.
